mainText: Hello, Verona! At 7 AM, here is today's balanced dish: we have fair conditions and a comfortable 70 degrees near Harriet Park. If you are looking to the stars tonight, the ISS will be visible for five minutes starting at 5:43 PM, rising over Mount Horeb and traveling toward the Fitchburg area high in the sky.

The Verona Municipal Court remains open this week to handle traffic and city ordinance citations, while the Plan Commission is preparing to review new development projects at the Liberty Business Park this December.

We have a packed schedule with live music at Bailey is Run today, followed by the Dane County Farmers Market and more live music at Paddy Mac is tomorrow. Plus, do not miss the music of John Denver at the High School Fine Arts Center this Saturday.
On October 23, officers made contact with two juveniles riding eMotos on Ashton Drive, resulting in their parents being cited for permitting them to operate a motor vehicle.
Today's flavor is Raspberry Cheesecake, which is a local favorite. The store opens today at 10:00 AM, so stop by to grab a scoop before they close at 10:30 PM.
